meta.description: Example lookup datamodel bundle. Authoritative types/values live in Postgres (Commerce.Api lookup_types / lookup_values). apps/sarees/src/config/lookups/registry.json is optional documentation only. JsonForm dropdown wiring: lookup-form-bindings.json.

invariants.typeParent: If lookupTypes[].parentLookupId is set, it must equal the id of another entry in lookupTypes (acyclic tree of types).
invariants.valueParent: For a dependent type, each valuesByLookupTypeId[typeId][].parentId must reference an existing valuesByLookupTypeId[parentLookupId][].id.
invariants.codeUniqueness: LookupEntry.code is unique within its lookup type id scope.
invariants.rootValues: For types with parentLookupId null, parentId on values must be null or omitted.
invariants.dropdownBindings: JsonForm fields are mapped to lookup types via apps/sarees/src/config/lookups/lookup-form-bindings.json (see formDropdownBindings example below). Commerce dev seed mirrors categories → product_categories lookup so ids match categories.id.
